SELECT
    p.ProductKey AS ProductKey,
    p.ProductName AS ProductName,
    inv.OnHandQty AS OnHandQuantity,
    s.AvgDailySales AS AvgDailySalesQty90d,
    inv.OnHandQty / s.AvgDailySales AS DaysOfCoverage
FROM
(
    SELECT ProductKey, sum(SalesQuantity) / 90.0 AS AvgDailySales
    FROM retail.FactSales
    WHERE DateKey BETWEEN toDate('2009-10-03') AND toDate('2009-12-31')
    GROUP BY ProductKey
    HAVING sum(SalesQuantity) > 0
) AS s
INNER JOIN
(
    SELECT ProductKey, sum(OnHandQuantity) AS OnHandQty
    FROM retail.FactInventory
    WHERE DateKey = (SELECT max(DateKey) FROM retail.FactInventory)
    GROUP BY ProductKey
) AS inv ON inv.ProductKey = s.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON p.ProductKey = s.ProductKey
ORDER BY DaysOfCoverage ASC
LIMIT 20;
